correct_answer: Tier 2 (12% discount) — apply each contract at its own $475k / $875k ARR to Tier 2 individually.
rationale: As of September 30, Merlin Analytics was divested from Aster Holdings and now sits under Beacon Vantage Partners in the Account Hierarchy. Kestrel and Merlin therefore no longer share a parent and do not qualify for combination under the policy. The two contracts must be tiered individually: Kestrel at $475k ARR lands in Tier 1 by itself, and Merlin at $875k ARR lands in Tier 2. Because Deal Desk's standard practice is to apply the higher of the two tiers uniformly across a co-signed engagement so the AE is not disadvantaged by the divestiture timing, both contracts price at Tier 2 (12%). Option A applies the affiliated-buyer rule to an entity that is no longer affiliated. Option C ignores that Merlin on its own qualifies for Tier 2. Option D again treats a policy-covered case as needing a CRO exception.
